title: Eylsia emerges with an empowering new single “Pull Me to the Light”
htmlContent: Eylsia's first single, "Pull Me to the Light," is a powerful reflection of her journey through tough times and emerging stronger. Having begun her sports career as a talented young tennis player, competing at big tournaments like Wimbledon and the US Open by the age of 10, Eylsia has lived quite an extraordinary life. She has also held important positions in music and luxury brands. However, with "Pull Me to the Light," she shifts gears from the boardroom and tennis courts to a more personal and emotional place. This song beautifully blends feelings of vulnerability and strength. With a voice that ranges from soft to powerful, Eylsia shares her story, inviting listeners to feel her struggles. Behind the uplifting melody, you can sense the challenges she faced, from injuries that ended her tennis dreams to the pressures of her corporate career. Yet, her lyrics express a desire for something more hopeful rather than feeling defeated. "Pull Me to the Light" is about coming to terms with the past and reaching for a brighter future. The music combines soft, sparkling sounds with grand arrangements, showcasing her strong voice. Each note feels like a step in her transformation as she reveals her true self. What makes this song stand out is its unique blend of being gentle yet powerful. https://open.spotify.com/track/6aud0SmVDK5aeh26haVk47 It's a powerful message that wherever life leads you, there's always a new part of yourself ready to shine, filled with hope. Eylsia's journey from child prodigy to influential figure in the industry to artist is truly inspiring. "Pull Me to the Light" serves as a beautiful beginning to this new chapter in her life. It feels like she's responding to her calling. In a noisy world, Eylsia truly connects with people. "Pull Me to the Light" is a guiding light for anyone who has ever had to start anew, reminding us that starting over can often lead to redemption.
